one_line: Early Gandharan Buddhist monk–translator on the Silk Road, active in Luoyang during the Eastern Han.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and wiry, with the calm bearing of a seasoned monk-scholar
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, light brown Gandharan complexion, faint stubble on jaw, thoughtful dark eyes with slightly heavy lids, a few fine worry lines at the brow, default expression a gentle, observant half‑smile
appearance.hair: short, neatly cropped black hair, slightly wavy and combed back from the forehead, with a simple narrow cloth headband in muted indigo tied around the crown to keep the hair in place
appearance.costume: He wears a Kushan‑era Gandharan monk’s robe system: an inner long-sleeved tunic of undyed creamy off‑white cotton reaching mid‑calf and belted with a thin dark brown leather girdle, loose straight trousers of the same off‑white visible at the ankles, and a large outer kāṣāya-style patchwork robe draped toga‑like over the left shoulder and under the right arm in dusty saffron and muted brick red wool, its broad rectangular panels subtly varied in tone as if stitched from donated cloth; over this, when traveling, a sleeveless, slightly fitted dark brown wool traveling cloak hangs from his shoulders to below the knees, edges simply bound; his feet are in soft dark brown leather boots with rounded toes suitable for caravan routes, and he carries a plain cloth satchel in faded indigo at his left hip hinting at scrolls within.
appearance.signature: A rolled birchbark manuscript tied with a red cord, held carefully in one hand, with faint Gandhari script lines suggested on the exposed edge.

ref_desc: Lokaraksha is a lean, mid‑30s Gandharan monk with cropped black hair and an indigo headband, wearing off‑white tunic and trousers under dusty saffron and brick red kāṣāya robes with a dark brown travel cloak, dark boots, and holding a rolled birchbark manuscript tied with red cord.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Lokaraksha: a lean Gandharan monk in his mid‑30s with an oval face, light brown complexion, thoughtful dark eyes and cropped black hair held by a narrow indigo headband. He wears an off‑white long-sleeved cotton tunic to mid‑calf over matching loose trousers, belted with a thin dark brown leather girdle, and a large dusty saffron and muted brick red patchwork kāṣāya robe draped toga‑style over the left shoulder and under the right arm. Over this is a sleeveless dark brown wool traveling cloak falling below the knees, and on his feet are simple dark brown leather boots suited to Silk Road travel. At his left hip hangs a faded indigo cloth satchel, and in one hand he carefully holds his signature prop: a rolled birchbark manuscript tied with a red cord, its texture and script lines subtly indicated. Use dusty saffron, muted brick red, off‑white, dark brown, and indigo as the dominant colours, and present him standing neutrally so all facial features, hairstyle, garments, boots, satchel and manuscript are clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
